Rajasthan police officer suspended over two separate incidents

Two separate incidents involving a Rajasthan police officer have led to her suspension. In one incident, the officer was seen putting her feet on a desk while an elderly complainant waited. In another incident, a video showed the same officer slapping a woman complainant at a hotel in Delhi. The police department has taken disciplinary action following the second incident, which sparked public outrage. The incidents have raised questions about the behavior of law enforcement officials in India.
